title: G30: add synthetic-only AI request count and identity checker
public_pr_body:
Delivers only a reusable read-only snapshot, offline comparator and synthetic tests. Real scenario B comparison: unverified here, owned by Code. Its evidence, report and wipe-kit files remain private and are not inputs to this PR or public CI. No private source or actual scenario record-level comparison is included.

snapshot.sql captures all-company counts, record UUIDs, company UUIDs and UTC full-row hashes without request text/model responses/keys. A tenant-filtered capture refuses rather than silently omitting other companies. compare.mjs accepts before/after files and an explicitly approved WIPE/KEEP policy, validates counts against every identity, checks other-company preservation, and lists every added/removed/moved/changed row without truncation. It binds input file hashes and exits nonzero on violations or invalid evidence. No DB URL or network access in the comparator.

Committed synthetic-only code d3c4d76: 9 passed, zero failed/skipped; lint and TypeScript passed. Tests create and verify their own nonce-labelled, pinned-image, network-isolated PostgreSQL container, no published ports, no existing DB. The public main 101 table definition and 82 synthetic rows (41 per company) exercise correct removals, wrong-company removals, owner changes, same-count identity replacement, content changes, malformed/duplicate/count evidence, filtered capture refusal and CLI output/exit behaviour. Complete synthetic before/after/difference manifests and SQL/identity provenance are archived with SHA-256; container removed.

G30: reusable checker ready, 9 synthetic tests passed. Real scenario B comparison: unverified here, owned by Code. Handover and usage: tests/reviews/g30/README.md. Separate clean branch from main 68f89ca; docs/tests only. No merge, production SQL, real data, #359/candidate edits, Ready label or message to John.
